class.name: OcgGeomapiProjectpointonsurf
class.brief_description: This class implements methods for computing all the orthogonal projections of a point onto a surface.
class.description: ! This class implements methods for computing all the orthogonal ! projections of a point onto a surface.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an empty object. Use the Init function for further initialization.

method.name: from_2
method.description:
Create the projection of a point

on a surface

method.name: from_3
method.description:
Create the projection of a point

on a surface Create the projection of a point

on a surface . The solution are computed in the domain [Umin,Usup] [Vmin,Vsup] of the surface.

method.name: from_4
method.description:
Init the projection of a point

on a surface

method.name: Init_1
method.description:
Init the projection of a point

on a surface . The solution are computed in the domain [Umin,Usup] [Vmin,Vsup] of the surface.

method.name: Init_4
method.description: Init the projection for many points on a surface <Surface>. The solutions will be computed in the domain [Umin,Usup] [Vmin,Vsup] of the surface.

method.name: SetExtremaAlgo
method.description: Sets the Extrema search algorithm - Grad or Tree. By default the Extrema is initialized with Grad algorithm.

method.name: SetExtremaFlag
method.description: Sets the Extrema search flag - MIN or MAX or MINMAX. By default the Extrema is set to search the MinMax solutions.

method.name: Perform
method.description: Performs the projection of a point on the current surface.

method.name: NbPoints
method.description: Returns the number of computed orthogonal projection points. Note: if projection fails, NbPoints returns 0.

method.name: Point
method.description: Returns the orthogonal projection on the surface. Index is a number of a computed point. Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if Index is not in the range [ 1,NbPoints ], where NbPoints is the number of solution points.

method.name: Parameters
method.description: Returns the parameters (U,V) on the surface of the orthogonal projection. Index is a number of a computed point. Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if Index is not in the range [ 1,NbPoints ], where NbPoints is the number of solution points.

method.name: Distance
method.description: Computes the distance between the point and its orthogonal projection on the surface. Index is a number of a computed point. Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if Index is not in the range [ 1,NbPoints ], where NbPoints is the number of solution points.

method.name: NearestPoint
method.description: Returns the nearest orthogonal projection of the point on the surface. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if projection fails.

method.name: LowerDistanceParameters
method.description: Returns the parameters (U,V) on the surface of the nearest computed orthogonal projection of the point. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if projection fails.

method.name: LowerDistance
method.description: Computes the distance between the point and its nearest orthogonal projection on the surface. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if projection fails.
